alarms.action: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops and jam alarm M190 is latched until fault reset PB-0002 (X1) is pressed
alarms.condition: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor motor M-1001 is running
alarms.name: Jam alarm

alarms.action: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops immediately and motor overload alarm flag M191 turns ON
alarms.condition: Conveyor motor overload relay MOL-1001 trips (X13 opens / turns OFF)
alarms.name: Motor overload alarm

conflicts.narrative_says: 5.0 s (entry photo-eye PE-1002 blocked > 5.0 s while conveyor runs stops conveyor and raises jam alarm)
conflicts.program_says: Not implemented (timer T10, PE-1002 input logic, and M190 coil logic are absent from the program)

interlocks.cause: E-stop chain open / unhealthy (ES-0001 / X0 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops immediately via fault relay M199
Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops immediately and ST10 motor overload alarm M191 turns ON

interlocks.cause: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 blocked for > 5.0 s while conveyor runs (jam condition)
interlocks.effect: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops and jam alarm M190 is raised

interlocks.cause: Auto mode not selected (SS-0003 / X2 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) is inhibited from running

interlocks.cause: ST10 fault active (M199 ON: jam M190, overload M191, or E-stop lost /X0)

steps.entry: Auto mode selected (SS-0003 / X2 ON) and no ST10 fault active (M199 OFF)
steps.exit: Auto mode lost (X2 OFF), E-stop tripped (X0 OFF), motor overload tripped (MOL-1001 / X13 OFF), or jam alarm active (M190 ON)
steps.name: Conveyor Run

steps.entry: Pallet conveys against spring stopper at test position and activates at-stop photo-eye PE-1001 (X10 ON)
steps.exit: Stopper drops on release request and pallet departs test position (PE-1001 / X10 turns OFF)
steps.name: Pallet In Position

steps.entry: Rising edge of line controller release request RQ-1005 (X14)
steps.exit: Stopper release pulse timer T11 reaches preset (2.0 s elapsed)
steps.name: Stopper Release
